scope.taper: Cosine weight from one to zero between 1.8 and 2.0 km to avoid an artificial crop-edge step
scope.interpretation: Four fixed published clone-minus-nominal perturbations, full inside 1.8 km and tapered to zero by 2 km; outer local/regional terrain is held nominal. Frequencies are conditional sample counts, not probabilities.
scope.numericalInterpretation: Numerical variants are a separate family; they are not added to the clone sample count.

observerCorrection.method: Translate the nominal apparent topocentric vector along the local radial axis, using its actual target range; validate against direct SPICE at start/middle/end for each variant, target and height.

ranking.method: Requirements first, then greater combined availability; ties within one observation bin. Rank spans use best/worst tested outcomes independently by site; they are conservative possibilities, not probabilities or matched global clone worlds.

fineStudy.description: Separate direct one-minute Shackleton study, not an automatic refinement of the current app inputs.

constructedThresholdProbe.description: Hypothetical limit chosen between sampled clone extremes; zero required Earth overlap isolates the darkness constraint. Not a real mission requirement.

benchmarkDefinition: The summary covers 12 fixed 10-minute scenarios and 36 per-site cases; the separate one-minute study and its constructed threshold probe are reported under fineStudy.
